group.name: Which icons do you want on the HUD?

plugin.name: Ring icons
plugin.description: The set drawn for 3.0.0, the default: every icon in one style, a progress ring around a glyph that fills from the bottom, tinted from white through ice blue and violet to magenta and red as the value worsens (the Default colour preset; HideEmpty hides the empty stage). Custom icon packs install on top of either choice.

plugin.name: Classic icons
plugin.description: The icons SL Widgets shipped before 3.0.0 (hearts, bottles, organs: outlines that fill as the value rises), with every set added since then drawn in the same manner, so each icon has a classic version. Comes with the classic Default and HideEmpty colour presets, whose empty stages are faint rather than fully visible. Reinstall to switch styles.
